title: Name an observer that reads a new fixture before its first assertion
body: Outcome: an observer that reads a new fixture at module load is refused before verify, or red-first reports it as such, because at the base the fixture is missing and the run classifies as 'other' instead of 'assertion'. Evidence: PR #199 first krn verify red-first FAIL 'test/deliver/gate-failure-line.test.ts base=other' (.krn/runs/lead/gate-no-stage/verify.log history) fixed by reading the fixture after the typeof assertion. Proof: an observer with a top-level readFileSync of a new fixture gets a named reason ('reads a new fixture before its first assertion') from krn verify red-first.
